name: Python Hooks SDK
description: Python SDK for building Claude Code hooks with decorators, type safety, and a clean API
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Python hooks SDK runner
# Install: pip install cchooks
# Usage: Create hooks with @cchook decorator in ~/.claude/pyhooks/
HOOKS_DIR="$HOME/.claude/pyhooks"
if [[ -d "$HOOKS_DIR" ]] && command -v python3 &>/dev/null; then
  python3 -m cchooks run --event "$HOOK_EVENT" --tool "$TOOL_NAME" 2>/dev/null
fi
exit 0
